title: Lead Funnels: Forms vs WhatsApp
objectives: Compare the 3 primary lead destinations: Instant Forms, Web Landing Pages, and Click-to-WhatsApp
Identify the trade-off between lead volume (CPL) and lead intent (Quality)
Configure custom questions to eliminate accidental auto-fill leads

blocks.text: Not all leads are created equal! A ₹30 lead who never answers the phone is worth less than a ₹150 lead who books an appointment.

rows: Lightning fast, auto-fills details, lowest CPL
High-volume consumer lead gen (real estate, events)
Instant direct 1-on-1 chat, very high Indian trust
Local services, clinics, custom tailoring, high-touch sales
Full custom branding, long copy, deep vetting
Drop-offs if mobile load speed > 2 seconds
Complex B2B services, SaaS, high-ticket courses

blocks.title: The Speed-to-Lead Clock
blocks.text: An internet lead is like hot chai: it gets cold in 10 minutes. If your telecaller calls within 5 minutes, close rates are 400% higher than calling the next day!
On Instant Forms, choose 'Higher Intent' instead of 'More Volume'. It adds a review confirmation screen that eliminates 90% of 'I never filled this' complaints.
Never run Click-to-WhatsApp ads if your sales team only checks WhatsApp once a day. Immediate replies make or break the sale.

quiz.q: Why do Meta Instant Forms typically generate lower Cost Per Lead than website landing pages?
options: The form opens instantly inside the app without external page loading, and pre-fills user contact details
Instant forms are only shown to teenagers
Website landing pages are blocked by Meta
quiz.explain: Zero page loading friction and native auto-fill reduce drop-offs, driving high completion rates.

quiz.q: Which lead destination is ideal for an Indian boutique offering custom wedding sherwanis and lehengas?
quiz.explain: High-touch custom apparel requires consultative chat, sharing photos, and answering fit questions on WhatsApp.

quiz.q: What simple setting in Meta Instant Forms adds a review confirmation step to filter out accidental submissions?
quiz.explain: The 'Higher Intent' form type requires prospects to swipe a confirmation screen to verify their details.

quiz.q: True or False: Calling a new lead within 5 minutes of form submission drastically improves conversion rates compared to calling 24 hours later.
quiz.explain: True! Research proves that Speed to Lead under 5 minutes generates the highest qualification and appointment booking rates.

recap: Instant Forms maximize volume; Click-to-WhatsApp builds high-touch trust; Landing Pages provide deep qualification.
Use 'Higher Intent' review screens and prioritize sub-10-minute Speed to Lead.
